The keyboard is visible, and an Intel Core i3 sticker is on the lower right of the palm rest. No photo shows the laptop running on battery, nor is battery health or runtime visible. The screen is on, but power source is not shown.
Photo 2 shows visible smudges and dirt on the palm rest and keyboard. The screen has glare and reflections, but no clear view of screen clarity. The overall condition appears used and not clean.

risks.if_unproven: priced as having no battery or very short battery life

risks.risk: Keyboard or touchpad may be faulty
risks.proof: A video showing typing and touchpad navigation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional keyboard or touchpad

risks.risk: Screen may have dead pixels, flickering, or poor clarity

risks.risk: Laptop may have physical damage or wear not visible in photos

proof_requests: Video showing the laptop running on battery for 30 minutes.
Video of typing and touchpad use.
Photo or video of the screen displaying a solid white and black screen.
Full 360-degree photos or video of the laptop.
response.reason: The laptop is identifiable as an HP ProBook with an Intel Core i3-3217U processor, but key claims about battery life, functionality, and condition are unverified or contradicted by visible dirt and smudges. Hidden risks related to battery, keyboard, screen, and physical damage require proof before pricing.
